instruction: UV Master Unwrap of a Head Mesh The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named Head, is a simplified head model: an ellipsoid (radius_x = 0.8, radius_y = 1.2, radius_z = 0.9) lat-lon subdivided to roughly 2000 quad faces (2114 vertices, 2178 faces). The mesh has no UVs in the input, a single default polygroup, and no subdivision-level stack above the base mesh. Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, Use UV Master to compute a new UV layout that fits inside the [0,1]^2 unit square without overlapping islands, and export the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj` with UVs preserved. The exported `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy: - Exactly one SubTool, still named Head, with its base geometry unchanged. - Every face has UV indices written out in the OBJ. - All UV values are inside the unit square [0,1]^2 (with a small numerical tolerance). - No UV overlap: the sum of UV-space face areas is <= 1.05. - UV coverage is reasonable: the UV-space area sum is >= 0.5. - Stretch is bounded: the worst per-face UV-stretch ratio, normalized by the median, is below 15.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(20); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(1); pyautogui.press('enter'); time.sleep(5)
